description: Change a recurring block FROM A DATE ONWARD (title, duration, fixed time, weekdays; for a task bucket, its filter). The past is never rewritten: earlier days keep their blocks as they were, and the habit keeps its history. Upcoming occurrences already created and not yet checked are updated, or removed if their day is no longer planned. To change a single day only, use update_day_block on that day's block instead.

anchor_time.description: Fixed wall-clock hour HH:MM. Pass null to let the block follow the wake time.

filter_due.description: Task buckets only: which tasks to show, by due date — today, overdue (today only), week (from this day to Sunday), asap, someday, all. null = the day's tasks (today + overdue + ASAP on today), the default. Every bucket shows ALL the open tasks matching its filter, even if another bucket shows them too; the app displays what fits in the block's duration (15 min per task without a duration) and the rest under « show more ».

filter_tag_id.description: Task buckets only: show only the tasks linked to this page (tag id, from list_tags). null = all pages.

from_date.description: First day the change applies (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: today (UTC).

id.description: Recurring block UUID (from list_recurring_blocks, or `repeats.recurring_block_id` of a day block)

weekdays.description: ISO weekdays the block comes back on: 1 = Monday … 7 = Sunday. Every day = [1,2,3,4,5,6,7]; working week = [1,2,3,4,5].

name: update_recurring_block
